## Opt-in diagnostics and trailer quality evidence

- Keep actual uncaught crashes, ANRs and abnormal process exits captured independently of logging switches.
- Move handled failures and TorBox state events to opt-in Basic logging. Network failures and verbose rendition, decoder, surface and player-state events require Detailed logging. Expected cancellations do not create failure reports.
- Label recoverable failures as WARN, not fatal crash events. Keep both logging switches off by default; existing enabled preferences are preserved.
- Record trailer YouTube IDs, available and selected format IDs, codec, bitrate, frame rate, actual decoder input/resolution, decoder name, dropped-frame batches, surface dimensions, fallback attempts and startup timings.
- Record fullscreen expansion, visibility, dismissal reasons and player/owner teardown so regressions can be traced. Do not log signed media URLs, authorization headers, credentials or response bodies.
- Preserve the yt-dlp removal and fullscreen handoff/navigation protections from the preceding local build.

Signed 32-bit release build. Trailer selection is unchanged; this build adds evidence for diagnosing quality differences. Physical-TV verification remains required.
